# comment: "Direction: subject (NABON) <predicate> object (ECCDM hub). Non-standard ext cols: subject_terminology (deferred, blank), source_context (NABON MDO phase: preoperatief|postoperatief|neoadjuvant|metastase|recidief), element_kind, mapping_cardinality, review_status. DURCHSTICH = model CancerConditionAtDiagnosis. source_context resolves the pre/post-op n:1 collisions: rows with the SAME object_id MUST differ in source_context. postoperatief rows are kept to surface a hub limitation (ECCDM collapses pre/post-op pathology into one field)."
